description_en: Queries the status of the DCDN WAF service, including the activation time, edition, current service status, billing method for requests, and billing method for rules
description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnWafService查询DCDN WAF服务状态，包括服务开通时间、版本信息、当前业务状态、请求数计费方式、规则数计费方式等
name: DescribeDcdnWafService

Enabled.description_en:
The service activation status. Valid values:

on: The service is activated.
off: The service is not activated
Enabled.description_zh:
服务开通状态。

on：开通
off：未开通

OpeningTime.description_en:
The service activation time.

The time is displayed in UTC and follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format
OpeningTime.description_zh:
服务开通时间。

时间采用 ISO 8601 格式的 UTC 时间，格式为 yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

RuleBillingType.description_en: The billing method for rules, billed based on the number of SeCUs
RuleBillingType.description_zh: 规则数计费方式，按SeCU数量计费

Status.description_en:
The service status. Valid values:

Normal: The service is running normally.

WaitForExpire: The service is pending suspension.

Expired: The service has expired.

Released: The service has been released
Status.description_zh:
业务状态，取值：

Normal：正常

WaitForExpire：等待停机

Expired：已过期

Released：释放
